condition. Infer direction from the record cards first, then judge transfer from

a higher transfer_likelihood must outweigh a concrete experimental mismatch.

every compound-specific empirical claim in the supplied query prior or cited
record cards. Repeated records and multiple cards from one context are not
independent evidence. Return exactly one valid JSON object and do not reveal
hidden chain-of-thought.

claims.claim: The query is a fully ionized aryloxyacetic acid at intestinal pH (logD -0.75), and L5 shows that a free carboxylic acid (ME3277) had poor absorptive flux unless its acids were esterified (C73), providing mechanistic evidence that the ionized acid form has low intestinal permeability.

Pravastatin, an acidic drug with a similar ionization profile, undergoes BCRP-mediated efflux in Caco-2 cells (efflux ratio reduced to 2.1 only in the presence of the ABCG2 inhibitor Ko143, C63), indicating that acidic substrates can be subject to gut-wall efflux that limits net absorption.

The closest aryloxyacetic acid fused-ring analog FK788 had low oral bioavailability in rats (9.6%, C28), and KNI-272 in a syrup formulation under fed conditions had F = 15.72% (C22), providing direct low outcomes that align with the mechanistic efflux/metabolism evidence.

Direct high-F analogs (FK788 human 55%, C07; etodolac 0.80, C13; cicaprost ~100%, C42) are structurally distinct and do not establish that this specific rigid benzindene aryloxyacetic acid avoids efflux or first-pass loss.
